title: The 5th lord is in a kendra or trikona

text.en: The lord of the 5th house sits in a kendra or trikona, which classical texts read as support for children.
text.impact: Matters of children are well supported in your chart.

title: The 5th lord is in the 6th, 8th or 12th house

text.en: The lord of the 5th house sits in a dusthana (the 6th, 8th or 12th), which classical texts read as strain on children.
text.impact: This is read as children coming later, or after some effort, which may include medical help. The tradition has no quarrel with that. It speaks about timing and patience.

text.impact: A strong indication for children, and for a warm bond with them.

title: Rahu or Ketu occupies the 5th house

text.en: Rahu or Ketu sits in the 5th house. South Indian practice, Kerala especially, associates this with sarpa dosha affecting progeny.
text.impact: Kerala and Tamil practice reads this as sarpa dosha touching this part of the chart. In practice it is read as delay that responds to patience and, where needed, to medical help.
